name: Create one album and add photos with chosen captions and frames
covers: create a replacement album after deletion
description: Verifies a creator can publish one album with selected photo notes and frame styling, and is prevented from creating a second.
steps: Sign in and create a profile with a picture
Create an album with two or more photos
Enter a note to display beneath photos and choose a frame option
Publish the album and open it
Edit the album title, description and quote and save
Edit a photo caption and rotation and save
Remove one photo and confirm it disappears
Delete the album and confirm the action
Return to the profile and create a replacement album
expected: The album and photo edits persist after reopening, the removed photo and album are no longer public, and the creator can create a replacement album.

name: Explore public albums and play soundtrack
description: Verifies visitors can view photos and play the album soundtrack only while exploring the album.
steps: Open Discover
Open an album with a soundtrack
Tap Play album song
Leave the album using Back to discover
expected: The album photos and soundtrack controls appear, and playback stops on exit.

name: Submit and approve special theme and verification applications
description: Verifies creators can apply for special themes and verification and the admin can review requests.
steps: Sign in as a creator
Submit a special theme application and a verification application
Sign in with the allowlisted administrator account
Open Admin studio and approve both requests
expected: The requests are reviewed and approved theme and verification changes appear.

name: Customize album themes and soundtrack
description: Verifies album visual choices and optional soundtrack are retained when published.
steps: Create an album with a free theme, selected font, layout and soundtrack
Open the album
Apply a special theme after admin approval
expected: The selected theme, layout and soundtrack appear in the album.

name: Enforce profile, album ownership and admin permissions
covers: public like count without optimistic double counting
description: Verifies server-side restrictions prevent duplicate albums and unauthorized changes.
steps: Attempt to create an album without a profile picture
Create one album
Attempt to create a second album
Sign in as a regular account and attempt to open Admin studio
expected: Missing profile pictures and duplicate album creation are rejected, and non-admin accounts cannot access admin tools.
